name: TA’AKTANA, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Labuan Bajo
insider_take: Perched on the edge of Komodo National Park, this ultra-luxury resort offers unparalleled access to one of the world's most biodiverse marine ecosystems.
whats_special: TA'AKTANA is the only luxury resort positioned as your gateway to UNESCO World Heritage Komodo National Park. The name "TA'AKTANA" means "our land" in the local Manggarai language, honoring the indigenous culture of Flores Island. With just 33 villas cascading down clifftops, each offering panoramic views of the Flores Sea where manta rays and whale sharks migrate seasonally.
pro_tip: Book the resort's exclusive Komodo dragon expedition during dry season (April-December) for optimal wildlife viewing, and time your visit with the manta ray season (December-April) for world-class diving at Manta Point.
dont_miss: The sunset cruise to Padar Island for Instagram-worthy views of the famous three-colored beaches, and snorkeling at Pink Beach - one of only seven pink sand beaches in the world, colored by crushed red coral mixed with white sand.
pros: Prime gateway location to Komodo National Park and dragon viewing expeditions
Luxury Collection brand ensuring premium amenities and world-class spa services
Stunning oceanfront setting with panoramic views of Flores Sea
Part of Marriott's exclusive Luminous Program offering enhanced luxury experiences
cons: Remote Indonesian location requiring multiple flight connections
Limited dining and entertainment options in surrounding Labuan Bajo area
